body:
Road conditions

  • (800)906-9069-Road conditions (from outside NE); 511 (from inside NE)
  • http://www.511nebraska.org/ndortip/index.jsp

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide,
  • Over 14'6" high,
  • Trailer over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Mobile homes/ modular homes- need hud # or seal #, manufactured (offline) date & insurance on file (If the insurance isn't on file, it can be faxed to 402.479.3906) 94,000 is max RW in Nebraska

Times Of Movement

  • 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset 7 days/week (however, no weekend travel in the cities of Lincoln & Omaha)
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas
  • (Permit office closed on above holidays plus Martin Luther King Day, Presidents’ Day, Arbor Day, Columbus Day, Veteran’s Day, & the day after Thanksgiving
  • Curfews: Omaha city limits: 7-9am & 3:30-6pm M-F; Lindoln State Highways: 7-9am & 4-6pm M-F/after noon Sat-Sun; Omaha State Highways/Interstates: 7-9am & 4-6pm M-F/after noon Sat-Sun

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://dot.nebraska.gov/business-center/permits/truck

Width:

  • Over 12' to 14'-Choice of amber light or 1 pilot
  • Over 14'-2 Cars
  • Height: Depends on route; Loads exceeding 14’6” in height may require a pilot w/ height pole.
  • Over 16’ in height a pre-run route survey shall be required & submitted to DOR

Length:

  • On interstate or divided roadway over 100'-1 pilot or proper light bar
  • No stipulations on 2 lanes

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Standard truck or car at least 60” wide
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign on front and/or rear of vehicle; minimum 5’ x 1’; 8” high black letters on yellow background
  • Lights: Revolving or rotating amber or yellow light sufficient to be seen 800’ (minimum or 50 candlepower bulb); 360 degree visibility; not less than 6” in diameter; mounted on roof a minimum of 53’ above roadway;
  • Flags: Red/fluorescent orange flags (min. 18” square) on all 4 corners of vehicle
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None stipulated
  • Dept. of Transportation Permits Office- Office hours: 7:30am-5:00pm; Closed Sat.
  • Dept. of Roads - Permit Office
  • 1400 NE Hwy. 2 Room 123A (walk-in)
  • P.O. Box 94759 (mail)
  • Lincoln, NE 68509
  • (402)471-0034
  • Fax: 402-479-3906/3907
  • http://www.dot.nebraska.gov
